headword: {金|かね}に{糸目|いとめ}をつけない
reading: かねにいとめをつけない
gloss: to spare no expense; regardless of cost

definitions.gloss: to spare no expense; money is no object
definitions.explanation: To spend as much money as it takes, without setting any limit, to get what one wants. Said of collectors, rich patrons, or anyone determined to have the best.

examples.english: To buy without regard to cost.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{金|かね}に{糸目|いとめ}をつけない。
examples.english: When it comes to his hobbies, money is no object.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{糸目|いとめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけず、⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{名画|めいが}→名画：17385_meiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めた→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: The company president spared no expense in collecting famous paintings from around the world.

notes:
A {糸目|いとめ} is the bridle string that holds a kite steady; a kite without one flies off out of control, as does money spent without a limit.
